rationale: Body-of-evidence synthesis, uncertainty taxonomy, saturation, and ResearchPriorityDecision exist and are lifecycle-integrated (3I.12–3I.14). No component transforms priority + unresolved uncertainty into ranked ScientificAction candidates. Exactly one general capability missing.

exactly_one_missing_capability.name: ScientificActionGenerator
exactly_one_missing_capability.description: ResearchPriorityDecision + EvidenceSynthesisRecord + PropositionRecord → ScientificObjectiveRecord(s) → ScientificActionCandidateRecord(s) → semantic dedup → pre-result lexicographic ranking → SELECT | HOLD | NO_HIGH_INFORMATION_ACTION → freeze action package → STOP (no execution)

answers.B_can_distinguish_informative_from_repre: PARTIAL — synthesis detects redundancy; no action generator
answers.C_can_generate_silence_when_no_high_info: PARTIAL — priority level yes; action candidate level no

proposed_next_phase: Phase 3I.16 — Minimal Scientific Action Generator (BB-NextAction-01 first, then T2 diagnostic, no execution)
